title: Rise, My Soul, and Stretch Thy Wings

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [C]Fire ascending seeks the sun; both speed them to their source;
[C]So a soul that's [Bb]born of God, [Am]longs to view His [Bb]glorious face,
[C]Forward tends to His abode to rest in His embrace.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [C]Soon our Savior will return, triumphant in the skies;
[C]Yet a season, [Bb]and you know happy [Am]entrance will [Bb]be given,
[C]All our sorrows left below, and earth exhcanged for heaven.
